# AutoDeposit

**Category:** Player  
**Aliases:** AutoDeposit

## What it does

AutoDeposit is the counterpart to ChestStealer : instead of pulling loot out of a container, it pushes items out of your inventory into whatever container you have open. Open a chest, barrel or shulker box and every stack matching your filter is quick-moved across, which makes it ideal for emptying a full inventory into a storage room or dumping junk blocks while building.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/player/autodeposit). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
